en_title: Marvel Tokon DLC Roadmap Reveals First Look at Jane Foster Thor, Venom and Jubilee Coming in 2027
cn_title: 《漫威斗魂》雷神亮相，毒液明年登场
subtitle: 阵容扩充，信任待修复
opus_summary: 《漫威斗魂》首年DLC公布简·福斯特版雷神首秀，毒液和李千欢将于2027年春夏登场。毒液还将带来共生体母星场景，但PC版技术问题引发的信任危机仍未消退。

paragraphs.en: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls will continue its Year 1 DLC roadmap with Thor (Jane Foster) this winter, with two more characters coming in 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 《漫威斗魂》的首年DLC将于今年冬季迎来雷神（简·福斯特），2027年还将有两名角色登场。

paragraphs.en: Developer Arc System Works confirmed the lineup alongside Evo France 2026. The Jane Foster version of Asgard's God of Thunder is now officially set to follow Phoenix Cyclops after he releases November 2, 2026, with today's announcement coming with both a sneak peek at her Marvel Tokon model in Odin's Vault on Asgard.
paragraphs.cn: 开发商Arc System Works在Evo France 2026期间确认了这一阵容。凤凰版镭射眼将于2026年11月2日推出，官方现已确定，简·福斯特版阿斯加德雷神将在他之后登场。今天的公告还首次展示了她在《漫威斗魂》中的模型，场景位于阿斯加德的奥丁宝库。

paragraphs.en: The clip doesn't show too much, only teasing that we'll probably see Jane fight off Loki while wielding Mjolnir when a proper gameplay trailer premieres at a later date. Arc System Works said she's scheduled to launch in Marvel Tokon "winter 2027," so expect to see her arrival sometime before March of next year. Despite some concerns from players that poor sales could jeopardize the Marvel fighting game's future, at least two more characters will arrive in spring and summer 2027, too.
paragraphs.cn: 这段短片展示的内容不多，只暗示在日后公布的正式实机预告中，我们可能会看到简挥舞雷神之锤妙尔尼尔，与洛基交战。Arc System Works表示，她计划于「2027年冬季」加入《漫威斗魂》，因此预计会在明年3月之前登场。尽管有玩家担心销量不佳可能危及这款漫威格斗游戏的未来，但2027年春季和夏季仍将至少迎来两名角色。

paragraphs.en: Yes, Spider-Man anti-hero and Symbiote menace Venom will finally join the roster in spring 2027. X-Men firecracker Jubilee will then follow in the summer of that year. While Cyclops and Thor are entering the fray as relatively lesser-known versions of themselves, Venom and Jubilee appear to be mostly straightforward.
paragraphs.cn: 没错，蜘蛛侠故事中的反英雄、危险的共生体毒液，终于将在2027年春季加入阵容。活力十足的X战警成员李千欢则将在同年夏季登场。镭射眼和雷神采用的是各自相对鲜为人知的版本，而毒液和李千欢看起来基本就是大家熟悉的形象。

paragraphs.en: That means Marvel Tokon players will get to see them fight the rest of the tag-team fighting with and against the game's roster – which includes characters like Doctor Doom, Iron Man, Carnage, Magneto, and more – in Arc System Works' heightened style. Although the details surrounding each DLC release are unclear, the reveal trailer did at least confirm that Venom will also come with a stage based on the Symbiote home world of Klyntar.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家将能在《漫威斗魂》中看到这些角色以Arc System Works的夸张风格展开组队格斗，与毁灭博士、钢铁侠、屠杀、万磁王等现有角色并肩作战或交手。虽然各个DLC的具体内容尚不清楚，但公布预告至少确认，毒液还将带来一个以共生体母星Klyntar为背景的场景。

paragraphs.en: It's all part of the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass, which costs $34.99. A roadmap with some of the most beloved characters from Marvel history would usually be enough to have comic book and video game fans frothing at the mouth, but uncertainty surrounding the project might have some looking at the Evo announcement in a different light.
paragraphs.cn: 这些内容均包含在首年角色与场景通行证中，售价为34.99美元(约合人民币234元)。这样的路线图汇集了漫威历史上几位最受喜爱的角色，通常足以让漫画迷和游戏玩家兴奋不已。不过，这个项目面临的不确定性，可能会让部分人以不同的眼光看待这次Evo公告。

paragraphs.en: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls launched to strong reviews (a 9/10 from IGN) in August, but at least on PC, players have struggled. Its Steam launch brought mixed reviews from fans who complained of widespread technical issues and PlayStation Network requirements. Even as the developers almost immediately promised to investigate the issues, it didn't take long for the backlash to swell to the point that famed fighting game community member Maximilian Dood wrote off playing the PC version altogether .
paragraphs.cn: 《漫威斗魂》于8月发售，获得了出色的媒体评价，IGN给出了9分，满分10分。但至少在PC平台，玩家的体验并不顺利。游戏在Steam首发时获得了褒贬不一的用户评价，玩家抱怨普遍存在的技术问题，以及必须使用PlayStation Network的要求。尽管开发团队几乎立即承诺调查这些问题，负面反响还是迅速扩大，甚至让格斗游戏社区知名人士Maximilian Dood彻底放弃游玩PC版。

paragraphs.en: It only took a few days for Arc System Works to push out a fix for most players' issues , but as Steam player numbers still struggle to break even 1,000 concurrent users (via SteamDB ), even the developers have admitted earning back trust will be "extremely challenging." While Marvel Tokon's presence on PlayStation 5 seemed to go over well, director Kazuto Sekine eventually went on to apologize for the PC launch .
paragraphs.cn: Arc System Works仅用了几天就推出修复，解决了大多数玩家遇到的问题。但据SteamDB数据，Steam同时在线人数仍难以突破1,000人，就连开发团队也承认，重新赢得信任将「极具挑战性」。虽然《漫威斗魂》PS5版似乎反响不错，游戏总监Kazuto Sekine最终还是为PC版的首发表现道歉。

paragraphs.en: The developers clearly have a game plan for at least up until summer 2027. While we wait to see how characters like Thor, Venom, and Jubilee will punch and kick their way into Marvel Tokon, you can read about the characters dataminers were expecting to see first .
paragraphs.cn: 开发团队显然已经制定了至少延续到2027年夏季的计划。接下来，我们还要等待雷神、毒液和李千欢等角色在《漫威斗魂》中亮出拳脚。
